loras.name: brdmc
loras.notes: Broderick recurring AUTHOR-AVATAR character-consistency LoRA (heavyset bald man, full gray beard, thick black rectangular glasses). Trained on 17 isolated avatar crops mined from his own strips with SHORT trigger-focused captions ('brdmc, <pose>') so the trigger binds identity. Layer with brdrck for same-character-any-pose in his ink look. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/broderick/hand/char/broderick_char.safetensors. On first fetch: aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/, backfill sha256+trained_at, set status='trained'.

loras.name: brdrck
loras.notes: Broderick ink/look STYLE LoRA v2. Retrained on 173 panels with SHORT trigger-only captions ('brdrck style') to fix the proven caption-binding defect in v1 (s3 .../hand/flux/broderick_flux.safetensors), whose trigger was inert because long content+style captions bound the style to description words. SUPERSEDES broderick_flux — do not register v1. Artifact: s3://ilyrium-slm-foundry/models/broderick/hand/flux_v2/broderick_flux_v2.safetensors. On first fetch: aws s3 cp into ComfyUI/models/loras/, backfill sha256+trained_at, set status='trained'.
